Strategy: Widen the gentle fifteen sweet band to residuals between twenty-eight and forty-eight with the penalty shifted to residuals between ten and twenty-five. This combines the widened band with a shifted awkward range, but the penalty shift is a guess and may punish usable residuals.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (15 if r - item >= 28 and r - item <= 48 else 0) - (15 if r - item >= 10 and r - item <= 25 else 0) for r in bins]
```
